Expressing probability

Les modaux indiquent ici un degré de probabilité. Le temps de la déduction est porté par la forme du verbe qui suit.

MIGHTfaible
MAYpossible · 50%
MUSTtrès probable
WILLcertain

Past

modal + HAVE + past participle
Code words must have protected the network.

Present

modal + BE + V-ing
The patrols must be searching the area.

Future

MAY / WILL + verb
Their story will inspire others.

Passive voice

Le passif place en sujet la personne ou la chose qui reçoit l’action. On peut ajouter by + agent si l’auteur de l’action est utile à la compréhension.

BE au même temps que le verbe actif + participe passé

Passer de l’actif au passif

Sujet de l’actifVerbe actifComplément d’objet → nouveau sujetVerbe passif

Active: Abolitionists guided freedom seekers.

Passive: Freedom seekers were guided by abolitionists.

Le complément freedom seekers devient le sujet. Le prétérit de guided est conservé dans were, puis guided prend la forme du participe passé. L’agent passe après by.

La même idée à différents temps

Fais glisser le tableau vers la droite si tu es sur un petit écran. Chaque phrase reste sur une seule ligne.

TempsActifPassif
Present simpleAbolitionists guide freedom seekers.Freedom seekers are guided by abolitionists.
PreteriteAbolitionists guided freedom seekers.Freedom seekers were guided by abolitionists.
Present continuousAbolitionists are guiding freedom seekers.Freedom seekers are being guided by abolitionists.
Past continuousAbolitionists were guiding freedom seekers.Freedom seekers were being guided by abolitionists.
Present perfectAbolitionists have guided freedom seekers.Freedom seekers have been guided by abolitionists.
Past perfectAbolitionists had guided freedom seekers.Freedom seekers had been guided by abolitionists.
FutureAbolitionists will guide freedom seekers.Freedom seekers will be guided by abolitionists.
Modal · couldAbolitionists could guide freedom seekers.Freedom seekers could be guided by abolitionists.

À retenir : le temps ne change pas, c’est BE qui le porte au passif. Le verbe principal devient un participe passé. By abolitionists peut être retiré si l’agent est déjà connu ou n’apporte rien.

Without the agent: Freedom seekers were guided to safety.

The whole argument

Economic interest pushed slavery westward. A legal border divided territories, but federal law and slave catchers could cross that line. Freedom seekers therefore depended on timing, hidden knowledge, trusted people, safe places and code. The border shaped conflict and identity, but freedom required organised resistance.
